devdoc.author: Ondo Finance
devdoc.details: This is a basic swap implementation that provides 1:1 swaps between a stablecoin         and USDon (accounting for decimal differences). The contract maintains forward         compatibility by conforming to the IUSDonManager interface for the subscribe         and redeem functions, even though this implementation only supports a single         stablecoin/USDon pair. This design allows for future expansion to support additional         token pairs.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

params._gmTokenManager: The GMTokenManager address authorized to call functions
params._maxOracleDataAge: The maximum age of oracle data before being considered outdated
params._stablecoinOracle: The stablecoin Chainlink price feed address
params._wallet: The wallet address that holds token reserves

redeem(uint256,address,uint256).details: This function has some effectively unused parameters to conform to the         IUSDonManager interface. `receivingToken` and `minimumTokenReceived` are used         purely for validation, but will be important in a multi-token implementation.

params.minimumTokenReceived: The minimum stablecoin to receive (6 decimals)
params.receivingToken: The address of token to receive (must match configured stablecoin)
params.rwaAmount: The amount of USDon to redeem (18 decimals)

returns.receiveTokenAmount: The amount of stablecoin received (6 decimals)

subscribe(address,uint256,uint256).details: This function has some effectively unused parameters to conform to the         IUSDonManager interface. `depositToken` and `minimumUSDonReceived` are used         purely for validation, but will be important in a multi-token implementation.

params.depositAmount: The amount of stablecoin to deposit (6 decimals)
params.depositToken: The address of token to deposit (must match configured stablecoin)
params.minimumUSDonReceived: The minimum USDon to receive (18 decimals)

returns.rwaAmountOut: The amount of USDon received (18 decimals)

InvalidOracleDecimals().notice: Thrown when the stablecoin oracle does not have 8 decimals as assumed

InvalidReceivingToken().notice: Thrown when receiving token is not the set stablecoin

OnlyGMTokenManager().notice: Thrown when caller is not the authorized GMTokenManager

OraclePriceOutdated().notice: Thrown when oracle price is outdated

StablecoinPriceBelowMinimum().notice: Thrown when stablecoin price is below minimum threshold

ZeroAddress().notice: Thrown when attempting to initialize with zero address

gmTokenManager().notice: The GMTokenManager contract authorized to call subscribe/redeem

redeem(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Swaps USDon for a stablecoin at a 1:1 rate (accounting for decimal differences)

subscribe(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Swaps a stablecoin for USDon at a 1:1 rate (accounting for decimal differences)

wallet().notice: The wallet that holds both stablecoin and USDon reserves
